qa_pairs.question: What kind of resource usage information is available for individual users within a group in the CPU account statistics on the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Within the "Utilisation détaillée par utilisateur" (Detailed usage by user) section of the CPU account statistics on the Metrix portal, you can find a breakdown of requested versus used CPU (in CPU hours) for each member of your group.

qa_pairs.question: How can users monitor the CPU core demand and actual usage for each individual in their group through the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Metrix portal, users can track the CPU core demand and actual usage for each individual in their group by consulting the "Utilisation détaillée par utilisateur" section within the "Statistiques d'un compte CPU" (CPU account statistics) tab. This section presents graphs illustrating the CPU (in CPU hours) requested versus used by each user in the group.
